title_zh: 政策—公共任务防误读层
purpose_zh: 把已登记政策转译为适用对象、普通任务、空间或服务动作、人工交接、停止条件与不可推导结论；政策只设置进入门，不替代批准、现场结果、责任接受或专业判断。
purpose_en: Translate registered policies into applicability, ordinary tasks, spatial or service actions, human handoffs, stop conditions and prohibited inferences. Policy sets entry gates; it does not replace approval, field results, accepted responsibility or professional judgment.

records.applicability_zh: 面向公共价值、民生服务与治理的 AI 应用方向；不是项目批准或投资配置。
records.applicability_en: AI directions concerning public value, livelihood services and governance; not project approval or investment allocation.
records.public_task_zh: 不依赖账户、扫码或智能判断，仍能完成同一公共任务。
records.public_task_en: Complete the same public task without depending on an account, scan or automated judgment.
records.spatial_or_service_action_zh: 把无人/智能服务放在连续普通路径旁侧；公共价值门、技术门和治理门任一不通过即不得升级。
records.spatial_or_service_action_en: Place unmanned or smart service beside the continuous ordinary route; no graduation if the public-value, technical or governance gate fails.
records.human_handoff_zh: 既有七项非 AI 公共权利和人工服务位置继续作为第一类基础设施。
records.human_handoff_en: Existing seven non-AI public rights and staffed service positions remain first-class infrastructure.
records.stop_or_escalation_zh: 普通任务被阻断、群体差距被平均值掩盖或人工路径不等价时停止验证叠层并退回 G0。
records.stop_or_escalation_en: Stop the verification overlay and return to G0 if the ordinary task is blocked, group disparity is hidden by averages or the human route is not equivalent.
records.not_proven_zh: 不证明本项目获批、获得资金、已形成服务能力或达到 G1。
records.not_proven_en: Does not prove project approval, funding, service capacity or G1 maturity.

records.applicability_zh: 仅限第三十九条列举的医疗、社会保障、金融、生活缴费等服务事项公共服务场所。
records.applicability_en: Limited to public service venues handling medical, social-security, financial or living-payment matters listed in Article 39.
records.public_task_zh: 在适用的办事事项中获得现场指导并可由人工完成办理。
records.public_task_en: Receive on-site guidance and complete an applicable service matter through a human-operated channel.
records.spatial_or_service_action_zh: 只有当候选服务事项落入法定列举范围时，才把清晰可达的人工服务台、等候与交接位置写入 G1 前置条件。
records.spatial_or_service_action_en: Only when a candidate service falls within the listed matters does a clearly reachable staffed desk, waiting area and handoff position become a G1 prerequisite.
records.human_handoff_zh: 工作人员受理正式事项；智能体只能做来源化导航，不代替正式办理或专业判断。
records.human_handoff_en: Staff handle formal matters; the agent may provide sourced navigation but cannot replace formal processing or professional judgment.
records.stop_or_escalation_zh: 事项范围不明、现场服务不可达、错误影响正式办理或无障碍专业复核未完成时维持 NO-GO。
records.stop_or_escalation_en: Maintain NO-GO when matter scope is unclear, staffed service is unreachable, an error affects formal processing or accessibility review is incomplete.
records.not_proven_zh: 不证明全部公园和数字界面都适用该人工办理条款，也不证明现状设施无障碍合格。
records.not_proven_en: Does not prove the human-service clause applies to every park or digital interface, or that existing facilities are accessibility-compliant.

records.applicability_zh: 全国适老化政策背景，用于传统服务方式与智能化服务并行的设计参照。
records.applicability_en: National elderly-inclusion policy background for designing traditional and smart channels in parallel.
records.public_task_zh: 老年人或不使用智能设备的人可通过传统渠道完成高频出行、消费、文化和办事任务。
records.public_task_en: Older people or people who do not use smart devices can complete frequent travel, consumption, cultural and service tasks through traditional channels.
records.spatial_or_service_action_zh: 保留同任务、同入口可见性和同等完成度的非 AI 路径，不把智能渠道设为唯一入口。
records.spatial_or_service_action_en: Retain a non-AI route with the same task, visible entry and equivalent completion; never make the smart channel the sole entry.
records.human_handoff_zh: 人工引导、纸质或静态信息、现场问询与可撤回路径保持可用。
records.human_handoff_en: Human guidance, paper or static information, on-site enquiry and withdrawal routes remain available.
records.stop_or_escalation_zh: 传统渠道缺失、完成度不等价或群体测试尚未取得时，不得把该背景政策写成已达标。
records.stop_or_escalation_en: Do not claim compliance when the traditional channel is absent, completion is unequal or group testing has not occurred.
records.not_proven_zh: 不证明海淀已实施、当地需求规模、服务覆盖率或特定场所法定合规。
records.not_proven_en: Does not prove Haidian implementation, local demand size, service coverage or venue-specific legal compliance.

records.applicability_zh: 仅适用于向境内公众提供生成文本、图片、音频或视频内容的生成式 AI 服务候选对象。
records.applicability_en: Limited to candidate generative-AI services providing generated text, images, audio or video to the public within mainland China.
records.public_task_zh: 用户能识别服务边界，并找到投诉举报入口、处理流程和反馈时间承诺。
records.public_task_en: A user can identify the service boundary and find the complaint/reporting entry, handling process and promised feedback timeframe.
records.spatial_or_service_action_zh: 相关候选服务申请 G1 前，必须预登记可访问入口、责任角色、处理流程和项目自定反馈期限；暂不填写虚构数字。
records.spatial_or_service_action_en: Before a relevant candidate applies for G1, preregister an accessible entry, responsible role, handling process and project-defined feedback timeframe; do not invent a number now.
records.human_handoff_zh: 争议内容和影响正式事项的错误进入人工复核与投诉队列。
records.human_handoff_en: Disputed content and errors affecting formal matters enter human review and the complaint queue.
records.stop_or_escalation_zh: 入口、责任、流程或期限任一缺失，或错误可能影响正式事项时，停止生成式叠层并维持 NO-GO。
records.stop_or_escalation_en: Stop the generative overlay and maintain NO-GO if the entry, responsibility, process or timeframe is missing, or if an error may affect a formal matter.
records.not_proven_zh: 不从第十四条推导一般退出权，不从第十五条虚构法定数字期限，也不证明已完成备案、安全评估或合规。
records.not_proven_en: Does not infer a general opt-out right from Article 14, invent a numeric statutory deadline from Article 15, or prove filing, security assessment or compliance.

records.applicability_zh: 本方案未来新增或公开展示的 AI 生成合成文字、图像、音频、视频或虚拟场景。
records.applicability_en: AI-generated or synthetic text, image, audio, video or virtual-scene content added or publicly displayed in a future version.
records.public_task_zh: 公众能够辨认内容是否生成，并能追到来源、争议复核和下架机制。
records.public_task_en: The public can identify generated content and trace provenance, dispute review and removal mechanisms.
records.spatial_or_service_action_zh: 保留显式标识、适用时的元数据标识、人工策展复核和无法核实时下架。
records.spatial_or_service_action_en: Retain explicit labels, metadata labels where applicable, human curatorial review and removal when verification fails.
records.human_handoff_zh: 争议由人工策展和权利复核处理，自动标签不替代权利判断。
records.human_handoff_en: Human curatorial and rights review handle disputes; automated labels do not replace rights judgment.
records.stop_or_escalation_zh: 来源、生成方法、模型、授权、同意或不可证明事项缺失时不得发布或应下架。
records.stop_or_escalation_en: Do not publish, or remove content, when provenance, generation method, model, authorization, consent or unprovable matters are missing.
records.not_proven_zh: 标识不等于第三方清权、人物同意、事实真实性、现场状态或安装批准。
records.not_proven_en: A label does not prove third-party clearance, participant consent, factual truth, field condition or installation approval.

records.applicability_zh: 公开报道中的顶尖科研人才、青年创新创业者、常住居民三类优先人群与五分钟支持方向。
records.applicability_en: Three priority groups and five-minute support direction reported publicly: leading research talent, young innovators and entrepreneurs, and permanent residents.
records.public_task_zh: 不同人群在三处原型中能找到与其日常任务对应的普通路径、问询和验证入口。
records.public_task_en: Different groups can find ordinary routes, enquiry points and verification entries matching their daily tasks in the three prototypes.
records.spatial_or_service_action_zh: 把三类政策人群映射到既有七类画像和支持单元，作为需求优先级与后续共测问题，不新增场景或虚构服务覆盖。
records.spatial_or_service_action_en: Map the three policy groups to the existing seven personas and support cells as demand priorities and future co-testing questions, without adding scenarios or inventing service coverage.
records.human_handoff_zh: 现场问询、社区共测和专业复核在未来真实责任主体确认后承担校验。
records.human_handoff_en: On-site enquiry, community co-testing and professional review validate the mapping after real responsible parties are confirmed.
records.stop_or_escalation_zh: 未取得现场基线、群体共同测试或责任接受时，只保留概念映射，不进入 G1。
records.stop_or_escalation_en: Keep the mapping conceptual and do not enter G1 without a field baseline, group co-testing or accepted responsibility.
records.not_proven_zh: 不证明已招募样本、完成调研、形成五分钟覆盖、获得伙伴承诺或实现服务绩效。
records.not_proven_en: Does not prove participant recruitment, completed research, five-minute coverage, partner commitment or service performance.

global_not_proven_zh: 官方空间边界、法定红线或场地准确落位
项目批准、责任接受、预算、人员、排班或恢复时长
现场服务结果、公众意见、无障碍合格或 G1 成熟度
独立法律意见、逐文件清权、商标权或安装许可
global_not_proven_en: official geometry, statutory redlines or accurate siting
project approval, accepted responsibility, budget, staffing, roster or recovery duration
field service results, public opinion, accessibility compliance or G1 maturity
independent legal advice, file-level clearance, trademark rights or installation permission
